prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Learn Desktop Pet Controls", "Master how to summon, position, and interact with your companion on your desktop in a few simple clicks.", "Start Quick Tutorial", "Essential Controls"]
1: ["Verify Companion Appearance", "Review your selected pet visual style and custom parameters before confirming adoption.", "Review Pet Specs"]
2: ["Calibrating Companion Traits", "Your pet's visual traits and behaviors are currently being synthesized and registered locally.", "Rendering Desktop Sprites...", "Estimated completion"]
3: ["Secure Your Companion & Account", "Sign in to permanently save your pet data and ensure your companion never gets reset upon app restart.", "Sign In to Protect Pet", "Automatic Cloud Save Enabled"]
4: ["Unlock Pet Dialog Options", "Discover how to talk, chat, and issue commands to your new desktop companion.", "View Voice & Chat Guide"]
5: ["Calibrate Desktop Placement", "Verify display bounds to ensure your companion floats smoothly over all desktop apps.", "Calibrate Display"]
6: ["Select Your Ideal Playstyle", "Choose between an interactive story companion or a light background desktop pet.", "Companion Mode vs Story Mode"]
7: ["Building Your Custom Companion", "Preparing graphics, animations, and voice synth engine for your desktop companion.", "Sprites compiled | Audio ready | Behaviors mapped"]
8: ["Official Adoption Ceremony", "Confirm your pet's official name, traits, and adoption agreement to complete registration.", "Enter Pet Name", "Sign Adoption Oath"]
9: ["Set Quick Summon Hotkey", "Configure a custom keyboard shortcut to instantly show or hide your companion anytime.", "Configure Hotkey"]
